scenes.tts: In the gonad of a worm larva, two cells lie side by side. They are named Z one P P P and Z four A A A. In every worm, one becomes the anchor cell. The other becomes a ventral uterine precursor. But which is which varies. Each cell takes the anchor fate in about half of animals.
scenes.caption: In the gonad of a worm larva, two cells lie side by side. They are named Z1.ppp and Z4.aaa. In every worm, one becomes the anchor cell. The other becomes a ventral uterine precursor. But which is which varies. Each cell takes the anchor fate in about half of animals.
scenes.visual: Two equal grey cells; one becomes the anchor cell and the other the uterine precursor; the fates swap in a second worm; a line says each is anchor in about half of animals.
scenes.narration: In the gonad of a worm larva, two cells lie side by side. They are named Z1.ppp and Z4.aaa. In every worm, one becomes the anchor cell. The other becomes a ventral uterine precursor. But which is which varies. Each cell takes the anchor fate in about half of animals.

scenes.tts: Kill Z one P P P with a laser, and Z four A A A becomes the anchor cell. Kill Z four A A A instead, and Z one P P P does. Whichever one you kill, the survivor always becomes the anchor cell. So the other fate needs a neighbour.
scenes.caption: Kill Z1.ppp with a laser, and Z4.aaa becomes the anchor cell. Kill Z4.aaa instead, and Z1.ppp does. Whichever one you kill, the survivor always becomes the anchor cell. So the other fate needs a neighbour.
scenes.visual: A laser removes one cell, the survivor turns anchor; the case is reset and repeated with the other cell; then a line says the other fate needs a neighbour.
scenes.narration: Kill Z1.ppp with a laser, and Z4.aaa becomes the anchor cell. Kill Z4.aaa instead, and Z1.ppp does. Whichever one you kill, the survivor always becomes the anchor cell. So the other fate needs a neighbour.

scenes.tts: Greenwald's thesis work, with Paul Sternberg and Robert Horvitz, tied the choice to a gene called lin twelve. With no lin twelve, both cells become anchor cells. With overactive lin twelve, neither cell does.
scenes.caption: Greenwald's thesis work, with Paul Sternberg and Robert Horvitz, tied the choice to a gene called lin-12. With no lin-12, both cells become anchor cells. With overactive lin-12, neither cell does.
scenes.visual: The three names appear with a lin-12 chip; with lin-12 crossed out both cells turn anchor; with overactive lin-12 neither is anchor.
scenes.narration: Greenwald's thesis work, with Paul Sternberg and Robert Horvitz, tied the choice to a gene called lin-12. With no lin-12, both cells become anchor cells. With overactive lin-12, neither cell does.

scenes.tts: Now take mosaic worms, in which only one of the two cells lacks lin twelve. That cell always becomes the anchor cell. What circuit between two equal cells could produce that?
scenes.caption: Now take mosaic worms, in which only one of the two cells lacks lin-12. That cell always becomes the anchor cell. What circuit between two equal cells could produce that?
scenes.visual: Two unnamed cells; one lacks lin-12 and becomes the anchor cell; the question is posed.
scenes.narration: Now take mosaic worms, in which only one of the two cells lacks lin-12. That cell always becomes the anchor cell. What circuit between two equal cells could produce that?
